prompt: How old would the founder of the publishing company of the magazine that serialized the manga series Raw Hero have been the year the magazine ended publication?
answer: The magazine was **Kodansha’s Evening**, which ended publication in **2023**. Kodansha’s founder, **Seiji Noma**, was born in **1878**, so he would have turned **145 years old in 2023**.
